reason: 该插件的主要用户价值在于在 DeepSeek Harness 对话中生成图片而非代码编辑或项目分析，归类为媒体工具。依据仓库说明与包元数据，它将 `generate_image` 能力接入 Agent 对话、支持多提供商图像 API，并在会话中回显结果，因此分类为 media-tools 且需考虑外部服务调用和凭据使用风险。

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 的对话中直接调用图像生成工具，支持多种图片生成服务与自有 API Key，并将生成结果展示在当前会话中。
summaries.en: Generate images directly within DeepSeek Harness conversations by adding a chat-facing image tool, using your own provider API keys to produce and return images in the conversation flow.

capabilities: Supports multiple external image provider APIs
Stores/uses provider credentials in DeepSeek Harness settings
Displays generated images in conversation context
Web plugin runtime/tool integration for DSH

reasons.code: README shows the plugin is a DeepSeek Harness-native image generation plugin where the Agent can invoke generate_image and return images in the current chat.
README lists supported providers (Gemini, OpenAI Images, OpenAI Compatible, Seedream/Volcengine) and configurable model/endpoint settings.
package.json marks this as a DeepSeek Harness web plugin with client injection modules, indicating integration into platform UI and toolchains.
